packageRules.description: TanStack packages share a release cadence and their types reference each other, so a partial bump is the one that breaks.
oxlint, its formatter and the type-aware binary are one toolchain; a version skew between them fails `check` in a way that reads like a code problem.
React and its DOM renderer and types move together.
Dev dependencies automerge on a green check. `bun run check` is the gate that makes this safe; without CI it would not be.
